newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said said Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies would hold a news conference on Wednesday at 1130/0930 GMT on EU aid to Germany's Brandenburg State after recent floods.
Van der Pas said Commissioner Anita Gradin would hold a news conference at 1215/1015 GMT on the draft convention on admission regulations for third world citizens to the member states.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/710: Commission publishes 1997 report on U.S. trade barriers.
- IP/97/711: EU structural funds for Northern Ireland: stronger emphasis on help for the unemployed.
- IP/97/712: EU structural funds for Ireland, a continuing success story.
- IP/97/714: The information society and developing countries: the role of the European Union.
- EU report on U.S. trade and investment barriers - 1997.
